questions.text: Will Valdoria's central bank raise its benchmark interest rate by at least 50 basis points in the next twelve months?
Will Valdoria's currency (the valdor) appreciate by more than 3% against major trading partners' currencies in the next twelve months?
Will Valdoria's central bank sell more than 5% of its foreign currency reserves in the next twelve months to support monetary policy?
Will Valdoria's year-over-year consumer price inflation rate be below 3% at the end of the twelve-month period?
Will Valdoria's central bank governor give at least two public speeches emphasizing price stability as the primary policy objective in the next twelve months?
Will Valdoria's government announce any new fiscal stimulus package worth more than 2% of GDP in the next twelve months?
Will Valdoria's unemployment rate decrease by at least 0.5 percentage points over the next twelve months?
Will Valdoria's real GDP growth exceed 2.5% over the next twelve months?
Will Valdoria's central bank implement any quantitative easing measures in the next twelve months?
Will Valdoria's stock market index gain more than 10% over the next twelve months?
Will Valdoria's wheat export volume decrease by more than 15% compared to the previous twelve months?
Will the price of wheat on Valdoria's commodity exchange increase by more than 20% from current levels?
Will Valdoria's government announce emergency agricultural subsidies or drought relief programs exceeding 2% of GDP?
Will at least three international news outlets publish articles specifically about crop failures or agricultural crisis in Valdoria?
Will Valdoria's trade balance deteriorate by at least 10 percentage points compared to the previous year?
Will Valdoria's agricultural sector employment increase by more than 3% compared to current levels?
Will foreign direct investment in Valdoria's agricultural sector increase by more than 25% compared to the previous year?
Will Valdoria's northern region report GDP growth exceeding the national average?
Will Valdoria's government revenue from agricultural export taxes increase compared to the previous twelve months?
Will barley futures contracts for delivery in twelve months trade at prices lower than current spot prices?
Will Valdoria hold a snap general election within the next twelve months?
Will at least two cabinet ministers resign from Valdoria's government in the next twelve months?
Will Valdoria's parliament fail to pass the annual budget on its first vote within the next twelve months?
Will a new political party or coalition form the government of Valdoria within the next twelve months?
Will Valdoria's prime minister be replaced within the next twelve months?
Will Valdoria's parliament successfully ratify at least three major pieces of legislation in the next twelve months?
Will Valdoria's government launch a new multi-year infrastructure development program within the next twelve months?
Will Valdoria negotiate and sign a new long-term international trade agreement within the next twelve months?
Will Valdoria's government increase public sector wages by at least 5% within the next twelve months?
Will all three parties currently in Valdoria's governing coalition remain part of the government twelve months from now?
Will Corvane Therapeutics' stock price increase by at least 20% from its current level at any point in the next twelve months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics issue a press release announcing positive data from the Velitrex phase 3 trial within the next twelve months?
Will at least two major financial analysts upgrade their rating on Corvane Therapeutics stock within the next twelve months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics announce plans to initiate regulatory submission for Velitrex to the FDA or EMA within the next twelve months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics announce a partnership or licensing deal specifically related to Velitrex within the next twelve months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics announce the termination or suspension of the Velitrex phase 3 trial within the next twelve months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics' stock price decrease by at least 30% from its current level at any point in the next twelve months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics announce a strategic pivot away from Velitrex as its lead program within the next twelve months?
Will at least two major financial analysts downgrade their rating on Corvane Therapeutics stock within the next twelve months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics announce plans to conduct an additional phase 3 trial for Velitrex due to insufficient data within the next twelve months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics announce a secondary public offering or registered direct offering within the next 12 months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics enter into a new credit facility or debt financing agreement within the next 12 months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics announce a strategic partnership or licensing deal that includes upfront cash payments within the next 12 months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics reduce its workforce by at least 15% within the next 12 months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics sell, divest, or out-license any assets from its early-stage portfolio within the next 12 months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics initiate a new phase 2 clinical trial for any pipeline program within the next 12 months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics acquire or in-license a new drug candidate or program within the next 12 months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics increase its research and development spending by at least 20% compared to the previous 12-month period?
Will Corvane Therapeutics open a new research facility or laboratory location within the next 12 months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics announce plans to expand the Velitrex development program into additional indications within the next 12 months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics announce a new CEO appointment within the next twelve months?
Will there be any SEC filings in the next twelve months indicating a change in Corvane's Chief Executive Officer position?
Will Corvane Therapeutics' proxy statement filed in the next twelve months show a different CEO than the current one?
Will any major financial news outlet (WSJ, Bloomberg, Reuters, FT) report on executive leadership changes at Corvane Therapeutics in the next twelve months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics hold a special board meeting announced via SEC filing that includes 'CEO succession' or 'leadership transition' in its description within the next twelve months?
Will Corvane's current CEO personally present the company's results at both of the next two major investor conferences (e.g., JPM Healthcare, ASH, or ASCO) within the next twelve months?
Will Corvane's current CEO be quoted in at least three separate press releases about company milestones issued in the next twelve months?
Will Corvane's current CEO appear as a speaker on all quarterly earnings calls conducted in the next twelve months?
Will Corvane Therapeutics announce a multi-year strategic partnership agreement signed by the current CEO within the next twelve months?
Will the current CEO of Corvane Therapeutics exercise at least 50% of their vested stock options within the next twelve months?
